messages:
alice_m: FYI — eu-west-1 GPU pool queue is steadily growing for the last 12m, autoscale didn't clear it. latency p50 jumped from 120ms -> 780ms. Anyone seen this pattern before?
benji_ops: Seen that once when cross-region spillover was failing due to route weights getting clamped. What does `kubectl get pods` show for the inference pool?
carla_infra: Logs look like a backlog on the ingress egress proxy: `503 upstream overload` spiking. I pulled the admission-control metrics: `queue_length=482`, `active_workers=64`, `max_capacity=80`. Autoscaler isn't spinning up — hitting zone quota for GPUs.
alice_m: @carla_infra thanks. Region quotas makes sense — eu-west hit quota, so the router should have steered to us-east-1 but that handoff seems to be rejected. I saw many `route-reject` with reason=policy_shallow_fallback in logs.
mike_sre: Can you paste the route engine decision line? we added the new tiering policy last week, maybe the spillover budget got consumed.
carla_infra: Paste from logs: `2026-03-18T14:02:12Z route_decision: spillover_candidate=us-east-1, reason=budget_exhausted, fallback=model_quant-7b-q4`, then next line `route_fail: egress_reject, reason=data_region_block`. So the router tried, but policies blocked due to data residency.
alice_m: Ah — so two blockers: quota in eu-west and data residency blocking cross-region routing. That explains the queue tarpit.
benji_ops: Short term: can we open a controlled spillover with exception for a small % of traffic (5-10%) to run on quantized fallback model in us-east? Lower risk since model is quantized and we can annotate calls for audit.
mike_sre: +1. If we do that we should add a circuit-breaker on requests/sec and tight tag for PII. Also route only non-sensitive customers. I can change the steering policy to include `allow_spill_override=true` for the next 30m.
carla_infra: I pushed a canary: updated steering-config `steering.v2 { spill_override { pct: 7, allowed_tags: ["non_pii"] } }` — deploy id `deploy-20260318-0732`. infra-bot: deployment succeeded.
infra-bot: deployment(deploy-20260318-0732) to cluster eu-west-1 completed 2026-03-18T14:07:03Z :white_check_mark:
alice_m: After the override we see queue_length drop from 482 -> 120 within 90s. p50 back to ~160ms. Nice.
benji_ops: Great. Follow-ups: 1) request quota increase for eu-west GPUs to avoid recurring; 2) revisit steering budgets so spillover budget is incremental not global; 3) add an alert on `route_reject:data_region_block` spikes.
mike_sre: I'll open the quota ticket with cloud ops and file a follow-up RFC for steering budget semantics. Also propose an emergency cheap-capacity pool (spot GPUs) for short-term absorb.
alice_m: Thanks team. I'll update the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/queue-tarpit and add the temporary override steps + checklist. Marking thread resolved unless we see recurrence. :thumbsup:
